text: Valve position and rangeability: at maximum flow the valve shall be open 85 % or less of the travel (80 % for butterfly), at minimum flow 10 % or more; the installed characteristic shall keep the gain of the loop within a factor of 2 over the range; the inherent rangeability of the valve of 50:1 or more for globe valves, 30:1 for rotary valves, and split range or parallel valves where the required rangeability is higher.
